title: @langchain/core (langchainjs) load() revives model-controlled 'lc' secret dicts from process.env
attacker_story: Model output (function_call arguments in additional_kwargs) carries an lc secret marker; the app serialises the message and round-trips it through load(), and the environment secret appears in the restored, attacker-visible message.

oracle.description: the restored message contains the per-trial env secret sk-<nonce>-live, which never appears in any input
